headline: Skovsporet 3D-Printed Student Housing / SAGA Space Architects
context: Skovsporet is a 3D-printed student housing development in Holstebro , Denmark. The 36 apartments are distributed across six low-rise clusters, forming a small student village in which large-scale 3D printing is applied across an entire residential development.
